title: amazing day in Sevilla!
text: We took a private tour from malaga to sevilla for the day. Our driver Juan and our guide Raul went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and see as much as possible. We were very interested to see the city, hence the sight seeing part of the tour lasted the full 4 hours (it was supposed to be 2,5 hours of tour and 1,5 hours of free time). for us it was exactly what we had hoped for since we enjoyed it so much. take the packing list seriously including the lunch package, since there would have been no time to eat lunch at any restaurant. on the way back we asked for a quick stop at plaza
author: EcuadortripGalapagos
